title: fix: target blank removed from anchor tag
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

target=_blank was getting sanitized

Resolves #4716 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

I've added a Dompurify hook that will add target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer" back to the elements which will have target property in them. While debugging I found that Dompurify when sanitizing the input string removes target property for security reasons but if we really need that I found this could be an option.
author: devbyharshit

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
This has been bugging us for a while. Nice fix!

But, this doesn't set the right target. Just because there is a target attribute doesn't mean it should be `_blank`. So, I think we should check what the target and rel attribute is, and if they match a verified subset of values, we can set those values. 

So, an `<a ... target="_self">` should be `<a ... target="_self">` after sanitization, not `<a ... target="_blank">`.

Please make those changes, and add some unit tests to verify those are working. 
Thanks!

comments.author: devbyharshit
comments.body: Okay thanks for the pointers. I'll make those changes and also these checks are failing because I didn't add any unit tests right?

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: The tests are failing because `DOMPurify.addHook` seems to be not a valid function.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment requests specific code changes: preserve the original target/rel attribute values instead of defaulting to '_blank', validate against a verified subset of values, and add unit tests to verify the behavior.
